brief: Prioritise vegetation and obstruction clearance work ahead of the heat event if any clearance defect is outstanding for this unit, as restricted airflow removes its cooling margin according to SOP-011. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, including the reason, value, and period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition is corrected and verified as specified in MG-021.
